records.subject: Matched horizon and selected edition count
records.what_needs_evidence: Actual window/start and edition/release version need agreement; common A/B basis must reconcile.

records.subject: Product, rights and benefit availability
records.what_needs_evidence: A licence/briefing/partner package requires actual releasable evidence, actual user/use and rights/capacity, not a product label.

records.subject: Willingness to pay and quantities
records.what_needs_evidence: All prices/customer/partner quantities remain untested until later evidence or explicitly labelled scenario values; no blank interpreted as zero.

records.subject: Event increment
records.what_needs_evidence: Whether a gathering adds useful research/member or commercial value is unestablished; compare remote/written alternatives.

records.subject: Initial and future research costs
records.what_needs_evidence: Map each work object to current commissioned scope versus genuinely additional/future work. Initial commission is not recurring production cost proof.

records.subject: Labour cash/resource classification
records.what_needs_evidence: Identify role/time, incremental payment and already-paid staff allocation; avoid overlap and invisible unpaid labour.

records.subject: City and seat feasibility
records.what_needs_evidence: UK pilot city/date, actual practitioner/host/moderator mix, private-room capacity and all-in supplier terms remain unresolved; Texas city not chosen.

records.subject: Payment, cancellation and cash timing
records.what_needs_evidence: Actual contract/receipt dates, deposits, refund and cancellation exposure are not supplied by general comparator terms.

records.subject: Currency, tax and service treatment
records.what_needs_evidence: Preserve original amounts/tax/service inclusions and dated FX; no assumed tax recovery or universal service percentage.

records.subject: Future periods and repeatability
records.what_needs_evidence: Renewal, later editions, continuing members and recurrent staff capacity are assumptions, not demonstrated by an annual programme.

required_boundary_tests: No sales/no partner: full costs and funding gap remain visible.
Equivalent free/bundled licence: no automatic second revenue.
One partner removed: its revenue/servicing and bundle rights move consistently.
Receipt delayed: profit semantics and bank cash diverge transparently.
Higher staffing/event cost: result worsens and funding needs do not improve accidentally.
Zero/negative licence contribution with positive gap: no false zero break-even.
Annual shared edition: not multiplied by cities.
Role overlap host/moderator: no double seat or hours.
Blank applicable input: visibly unresolved, not silently zero; irrelevant unselected route inputs do not block a valid selected case.
